meta.source: Mini Lights Measurement Quick Guide (Canva deck, 38 pages, built by YLL staff from 2025-season install photos)
meta.extraction_method: Page images read by assistant; customer names given per deck page by Naldo; addresses from the 2025 Ornament List roster (Google Drive)
meta.spacing: 6 inch bulb spacing everywhere (Naldo, 2026-08-28): one 50-count 5MM strand covers 25 ft
meta.unit: counts are STRANDS installed per plant item unless noted
meta.photo_convention: each house has a lights-on night page (labeled blobs per item) and a lights-off day page (red handwritten tallies per item); day photos are the measurement substrate, night labels are the count truth
meta.status: section 1 (bushes/shrubs) fully named; section 2 (tall shrubs/trees, pages 21-31) awaiting customer names
meta.known_conflicts: recorded per house in flags; resolve during tracing, never silently
